description: Open RAG development probes over selected editions from the curated20 pool and three audited Russian original short works. Never a closed/final benchmark. Facts need human review; exact source integrity is separately measurable.
licenses: Software evaluation code is MIT. Quoted fragments retain the rights/license and attribution of their source records, including Wikisource transcription CC BY-SA 4.0.
source_snapshot_policy: Bind edition artifact SHA, canonical book SHA, exact evidence section SHA/offset/quote and contributor metadata; fail closed on mismatched source snapshots.
automatic_checks: canonical citation text/span/hash and bibliographic metadata
supporting quote membership and cited source IDs
reference anchor presence in retrieved/cited passages, not semantic entailment
manual_checks: every expected fact is correct and sufficiently supported
claim/quote semantic entailment, omissions and overgeneralization
answer-language appropriateness and nuanced speaker/contributor attribution
